method: Hand-assembled aggregation of committed records, per manifests/design-evidence-tiers.md item 8 (no klt aggregation verb exists; upstream tracker klayout-tools#309). Records aggregated: sim/solve/records/2026-11-21-rows1-4-fulltable.md (spec rows 1-4, re-graded on the full 225-cell table of issue #277; the reduced-table sim/solve/records/2026-11-05-rows1-4.md remains committed, unedited), sim/sensitivity/records/2026-11-05-grid-sensitivity-partial.md (sensitivity matrix and conditioning), sim/solve/mc/yield-sized-bank.json with sim/solve/mc/RECORD-2026-11-06-item6-sized-bank.md (mismatch-MC yield), sim/power/records/2026-11-05-power-complete.md (spec row 7), layout/README.md (spec row 8 analog share), drc/README.md, lvs/README.md and sim/pex/README.md with sim/pex/records/2026-11-11-grade-extracted-values.json (spec row 9 analog share). SIMULATED throughout: schematic-level ngspice-46 on sky130A open_pdks c6d73a35 (sim/pdk.json) for the base analog runs, ngspice-47 on open_pdks f6eeac7 for the five single-cell cold fills, klt tool output on drawn layout for DRC/LVS/PEX.
summary: T1 item 8 (Characterization report), analog partition. SIMULATED aggregation of already-committed records; no simulation, extraction or Monte Carlo was run for it, and no spec bound or recorded verdict is changed. Indexed by spec/target-spec.md section, not by T1 item. Spec row 1 PASSES target and fallback on the full table (225 of 225 oscillator cells resolve; two of the seven cold fills rest on relaxed-solver values whose bias at the filled cells is not bounded); row 2 FAILS the five-corner target (8 of 9 (V,T) cells identified, the 1.98 V / 27 C fs->tt confusion) and PASSES the slow/fast fallback; row 3 FAILS the target (worst p99 |dV| = 34 mV at ff / 1.80 V / 125 C) and PASSES the fallback; row 4 FAILS target and fallback (worst p99 |dT| = 36.0 C at sf / 1.62 V / 125 C, 45 of 45 cells graded on the full five-oscillator bank -- worse than the reduced-table 19.0 C because the previously ungradable cells fail harder); row 7 active and idle power FAIL target, fallback and stretch; the analog share of row 9 FAILS target and fallback (4.analog and 7.analog are both unmet). This envelope is 'fail'. Rows recorded as NOT RECORDED, listed rather than omitted: row 8 (area) has no whole-block verdict in any committed record -- only the oscillator footprint share, 16 720 um2, which layout/README.md explicitly does not pass/fail -- and the row 1 second-library stretch, the row 2 continuous-skew stretch and the row 3/4 stretches have no record. The sensitivity matrix and its conditioning are shown before any estimate row (absolute kappa 27.8-67.9, ratio-only 19.8-67.9, rank 4/4, matrix formed in 5 of 9 (V,T) cells -- the 2026-11-05 sensitivity record's figures, not yet re-recorded on the full table). No estimate accuracy is quoted: the row 3/4 figures are graded failures against those rows' limits on the 3x3 (V,T) grid points only. Nothing here is measured.
